issues.problem: NVIDIA's fiscal 2025 operating income was about $81.5 billion. $33.0 billion is the fiscal 2024 figure. Since net income is $72.9 billion, operating income can't plausibly be $33.0 billion.

data.summary: Most of the figures are correct: revenue of $130.5B, up about 114% from $60.9B; net income of $72.9B; total assets of $111.6B; and cash and cash equivalents of $8.6B. The operating income figure is wrong. It shows the fiscal 2024 value ($33.0B) instead of fiscal 2025 (about $81.5B). The note in the text saying all figures are pre-verified was not taken as a reason to skip checking them.
